charts.title: How the test was built: one score, a planted check and two controls read in order.
charts.takeaway: The score had to see planted regularity first; then the real systems met two controls, and only the second is about sequence.
charts.n: 122 systems with four or more planets (543 planets)

steps.label: 122 systems, 543 planets
steps.detail: NASA Exoplanet Archive, systems with four or more planets, sorted by period.

steps.label: Fit three forms, score each
steps.detail: Plain, Blagg-Richardson style and gapped. Score S is minus the median residual over mean gap.

steps.label: Planted systems score −0.050
steps.detail: Exactly log-linear periods with 5 percent jitter. Bar to clear: −0.190.

steps.label: Control 1: pooled gaps
steps.detail: Rebuild each system from gaps drawn from all systems, 2,000 times. Asks whether a system's gaps resemble each other.

steps.label: Control 2: order shuffled
steps.detail: Keep each system's gaps, shuffle their order, 2,000 times. Asks whether the order is regular.

steps.label: Rule: real score above the control's 95th percentile
steps.detail: Fixed before the data were read, with at least 60 systems.

steps.label: Sequence claim
steps.detail: Control 1 beaten (p 0.0005). Control 2 not beaten by any form.

charts.title: Planted check: does the score see regularity that was put there?
charts.takeaway: Planted systems score −0.050, far above the pooled-gap control's 95th percentile of −0.190.
charts.units: regularity score S: minus the median over systems of fit residual divided by mean gap, both in ln period; higher is more regular
charts.n: 122 planted systems with the real systems' planet counts; 2,000 control draws
charts.interval: 5th to 95th percentile of the control draws
charts.baseline: Pooled-gap control: each system rebuilt from gaps drawn from all systems
charts.threshold: Planted score above the control's 95th percentile (−0.190)

axis.label: regularity score S (higher is more regular)

charts.title: Real regularity scores against each control's range.
